about_the_game:
You are a mech. You collect iron. But unlike every other mech trapped in the endless extraction cycle, you choose to build something better.

Ironweld asks: what kind of combat feels right to YOU?

Some build mechs that wait, read enemy patterns, and strike at perfect moments. Every successful counter feels earned. Every perfectly-timed punish proves you read the situation correctly.

Others build for relentless offensive pressure, chaining attacks until enemies can't recover. Every overwhelmed opponent validates that your momentum works. Every sustained string proves your aggression pays off.

Others build tactical systems around ability management and execution timing. Every controlled engagement confirms your strategy. Every well-timed rotation shows your planning was right.

This isn't picking a preset class. This is building YOUR combat system from the ground up, testing if it works, and feeling the satisfaction when it does.

Same tools. Completely different results. All yours.

Your Combat, Your Way

Choose every attack. Ground strings, air launchers, directional strikes, special techniques. Command inputs for critical moments. Build the moveset that makes sense to you. Test it. Refine it until it feels perfect.

Equipment That Proves Your Vision

Install parts that validate your approach. Close-range dominance. Sustained chain offense. Health-draining aggression. Defensive mastery. Watch your build come together exactly how you imagined.

Power That Escalates

Start grounded. Build intensity. Unleash devastating super moves when you've earned them. Feel your combat grow more explosive as you prove you can handle it.

Expand Your Creation

Unlock more move slots. Add equipment capacity. Your system grows as complex as you want it to be. No limits except what you choose to build.

Break the cycle

  • The World: Iron and oil are running out. Every mech mines alone, hoarding resources in a lawless scramble for survival. First come, first served. No order. No future. Just endless extraction until there's nothing left.

    Your Choice: You wake with something no other mech has - the ability to choose differently. You see the waste, the chaos, the inevitable collapse. So you decide to build something better: a system where resources are managed together, distributed fairly, sustained for everyone.

    The Cost: Not every mech wants change. Some attack you for threatening their routine. Others ignore you, too deep in their cycles to notice. But some listen. Some join. You unite them, one by one, building something that's never existed.

name: Ironweld

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU @ 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with OpenGL ES 3.0 support and 2 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated Sound Card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU @ 2.5 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with OpenGL ES 3.0 support and 4 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated Sound Card

short_description: 2D Mech Action RPG where you break the endless extraction cycle by building your combat. Combo chains? Ability rotations? Counter-precision? Your creation. Your expression.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Japanese, Russian, Simplified Chinese
